# Actions/FAB button

A floating action button for a prominent action. Compare the icon-only and extended label variants.

## Identity

- Class: `FabButtonComponent`
- Selector: `button[dlFab]`
- Kind: standalone component
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/actions/fab-button.component.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/actions/fab-button.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone FabButtonComponent from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Apply this selector to a native `<button>` and keep an explicit closing `</button>` tag. Preserve native disabled, type and keyboard semantics.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.
